description: This file declares the HttpServerPropertiesManager class responsible for serializing/deserializing HttpServerProperties, reading from and writing to preferences, and managing related network server info within the Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpServerPropertiesManager
classes.description: Manages serialization/deserialization of HTTP server properties, preferences, and network info, with methods for reading/writing preferences and handling server data.

methods.name: HttpServerPropertiesManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with preferences delegate, callback, log, and clock.

methods.name: ReadPrefs
methods.description: Populates server info and network data from preferences.

methods.name: WriteToPrefs
methods.description: Updates preferences with provided server info and network data.

methods.name: set_max_server_configs_stored_in_properties
methods.description: Sets maximum number of server configs stored.

methods.name: OnHttpServerPropertiesLoaded
methods.description: Callback invoked when server properties are loaded.
